description: High-latitude night birth on non-default settings. Exercises the Placidus/Krishnamurti path and the true node, so a regression in settings plumbing cannot hide behind the Lahiri/Porphyrius defaults. 51.5N is far enough north that Placidus cusps diverge noticeably from Porphyrius.

referenceSource.doctrine: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra (R. Santhanam translation), C23_BPHS_Santhanam.pdf

review.note: Values recorded from this repository's own engine to detect drift. Not yet signed off against an independent published chart; see fixtures/README.md.
